name: fanned phone mockups show the content and where it posts
looks: A headline names a content type, then two or three phone mockups fan out from a main centred one, each slightly offset in position and rotation, each screen showing a different piece of short-form video content. The headline changes and a row of platform icons fades in below a fresh set of fanned phones, now posting the same content across them.
build: Phone mockups are DOM panels with kit.rng-seeded offset x/y/rotation, staggered entrance 10-30% uneven on a spring; platform icons fade/scale in on a short even stagger beneath a second fanned set.
sound: A soft cluster of hits as the phones fan out, a light tick per platform icon landing.
prompt: Fan two or three phone mockups out from a centred one, each offset in position and rotation, each screen showing different short-form content, while a headline names what kind of content it is; follow with a row of platform icons fading in below a fresh fanned set to show the same content going out everywhere.
